text.description_html:
DOR-M9050TLGA Grade 1 Commercial Mortise Lock Sets

These premium performance locksets are built with a heavy-duty mortise chassis for all applications where ANSI/BHMA A156.13 Grade 1 products are required. To meet the aesthetic needs of your project, these versatile locks are available in a range of lever and knob trim designs and finishes

Complies with ANSI A156.13-2002, Series 1000, Grade 1. Listed by UL / ULC for ratings of “A” label (3 hours) and less

Hurricane code approved to Miami-Dade County Florida acceptance No. 15-0630.04 and 15-0630.05.

Specifications for the Dorma M9000 Series Mortise Locksets:

  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" -2-1/4"
  • Deadbolt (for deadbolt functions): Stainless steel.
  • Latchbolt: 3/4" Throw / Investment Cast Stainless Steel /Anti-friction Standard
  • Door Prep: Fits standard mortise 86 door prep.
  • Backset: 2-3/4"
  • Hand Case: Handed. Reversible in field.
  • Trim: LG levers solid cast/ forged brass or stainless
  • Lever Length: 4-3/8"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-1/4"
  • Strike: ANSI 1-1/4" x 4-7/8" curved lip
  • Cylinder: Temporary SFIC with Core Schlage "C" Keyway
  • Cylinder: Brass 6-pin cylinder keyed to 5 pins; 1-1/8" long standard mortise lock cylinder.
  • Certifications: ANSI A156.13, Series 1000, Grade 1. Meets all accessibility requirements of the ADA. Conforms to Federal Specifications FF-H-106 Type 86.
  • Finish: Satin Bronze
  • Function: Office Entry
  • DOR-M9050CLCGA Specifications (PDF)
